decisions.what: Used label wrapping file input to implement Import Tasks button
decisions.why: File import requires a file input element; wrapping it in a styled label provides button-like UX while maintaining accessibility and correct semantics.

decisions.what: Added visually-hidden h2 to actions section
decisions.why: HTML code generation rules require every section to have a heading. The actions section had no visible heading in the spec, so a visually-hidden heading was added for accessibility compliance.
The task is a landing-page-level interactive SPA shell, matching Tier 2 (Standard). Included ARIA labels, meta description, skip link, and semantic HTML5 structure.
